focused.command: KONT_DESKTOP_CANDIDATE=<absolute frozen candidate> node --test tests/desktop-candidate.test.mjs tests/client-bundle.test.mjs tests/desktop-candidate-isolation.test.mjs

acceptedScope: Explicit source allowlist produces reproducible 25-file sibling directory candidate, preserving local file dependency
Candidate manifests narrow existing exact-version alternatives to official installed Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2; package source unchanged
Output overwrite, unsafe overlap, redirected parent, changed bytes, unexpected files/directories and digest mismatch are rejected
Includes current server/query/panel/client/core and excludes evidence/tests/node_modules/credentials/user data
Independent official offline manager installation in fresh temporary profile, followed by copied runtime and renderer factory checks
Concrete later deployment/rollback plan identifies that old mutable repo spec is not an old-code rollback artifact
limitations: No installation into or restart of the running Desktop; isolated enabled:false plus restart-required does not prove hot load or active Desktop deployment
Runtime apply is a separate isolated official Cordis/WebServer check, not manager-driven running Desktop assembly
Renderer factory/slots/style disposal is programmatic assembly evidence, not actual ReactDOM/layout or human experience acceptance
No network package installation, portable standalone tarball claim, model run or new execution authorization
No prior installed-code rollback artifact has been captured or verified; later actual deployment requires that step and separate authorization
No full-suite or full-product acceptance; original frozen protocol coverage is unchanged
